candidateProtonColorSingletEnvelopeLemma.statement: If one retained event record supplies the accepted proton branch-interface ledger, same sigma_eff domain, same-record Noether sea response, same-record branch interface, bounded proton open-color projection ratio E_color_pX <= Delta_color_pX, finite proton envelope boundary R_p, refinement-stable proton envelope window, and accepted no_free_color_asymptotic_state, then the packet has the proton envelope support rows needed before accepted_proton_color_singlet_envelope can be promoted.

proofSteps.derivation: Require Pi_singlet,X, Pi_open,X, W_locked_pX, the proton branch-interface ledger, sigma_eff domain, and Noether sea response to resolve to the same retained event id.
Use E_color_pX = ||Pi_open,X W_locked_pX||_X/(||Pi_singlet,X W_locked_pX||_X + epsilon_pX) <= Delta_color_pX with epsilon_pX>0 as the proton color-singlet closure support row.
Require a finite proton boundary scale R_p and a refinement-stable window for the retained proton envelope.
Consume no_free_color_asymptotic_state only when it shares the proton envelope domain and is accepted source evidence, not prose or target-only blocker text.

Feed proton_color_singlet_closure and finite_envelope_boundary only into accepted_proton_color_singlet_envelope and downstream color-singlet/no-open-color rows after the accepted no-free-color audit exists.
